messages.author: aa8d8a5c39930fde
messages.subject: dev=tikz doesn't work
parts:
knitr (v 0.3) work perfectly for me when I use dev=pdf, but when I modify it to dev=tikz I get the following error, once for each figure:

Error : failed to compile <fig_file>.tikz to PDF

I updated the tikzDevice package and knitr to the latest versions, and I believe I have a recent tikz/pgf installation. 

Any ideas on how I can debug this?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] dev=tikz doesn't work
parts:
You can open that <fig_file>.tikz and see if you can find anything suspicious.

Or try to compile it to PDF directly by

pdflatex filename.tikz

and see filename.log if there are LaTeX errors.

Yet another thing to mention is be aware of special characters in your
plot, and you might need sanitize=TRUE.

Regards,
Yihui
